ko.title: 메타가 젊은 사용자들을 대하는 방식을 바꿀 수 있는 오클랜드 재판 내부

segments.src: A closely watched federal trial got underway today in Oakland, California, opening what many legal observers describe as one of the most consequential consumer-protection cases involving a technology company in recent memory.
segments.tr: 지켜보는 눈이 많은 연방 재판이 오늘 캘리포니아주 오클랜드에서 시작되었으며, 많은 법률 관찰자들이 최근 기억 속 기술 기업과 관련된 가장 중대한 소비자 보호 소송 중 하나로 묘사하는 사건의 막이 올랐습니다.

segments.src: Four states have brought claims against Meta Platforms, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, alleging that the company built and maintained product features that kept young users engaged in ways that caused them harm.
segments.tr: 4개 주는 인스타그램과 페이스북의 모회사인 메타 플랫폼을 상대로 소송을 제기하며, 회사가 젊은 사용자들을 해를 끼치는 방식으로 계속 몰입하게 만드는 제품 기능을 구축하고 유지했다고 주장했습니다.

segments.src: The case is the first bellwether trial to emerge from a much larger coalition of 29 states pursuing similar claims, meaning its outcome could set the tone for dozens of related lawsuits still waiting in the wings.
segments.tr: 이번 사건은 유사한 주장을 추구하는 29개 주의 훨씬 더 큰 연합에서 나온 첫 번째 선도 재판으로, 그 결과가 아직 대기 중인 수십 건의 관련 소송 분위기를 좌우할 수 있음을 의미합니다.

segments.src: ## What the States Are Alleging
segments.tr: ## 주들이 주장하는 내용

segments.src: According to court filings, attorneys representing the states argue that Meta's product teams studied how design elements such as infinite scroll, autoplay video, push notifications, and algorithmically curated feeds affect user behavior, and that the company chose to deploy features it knew could be habit-forming, particularly among teenagers and pre-teens.
segments.tr: 법원 서류에 따르면, 주들을 대표하는 변호사들은 무한 스크롤, 자동 재생 비디오, 푸시 알림, 알고리즘으로 선별된 피드와 같은 디자인 요소가 사용자 행동에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 메타의 제품 팀이 연구했으며, 회사가 특히 청소년과 어린이들 사이에서 습관성 중독을 유발할 수 있음을 알면서도 기능을 배포하기로 선택했다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: The states contend that internal research and communications, some of which have already surfaced through prior congressional inquiries and whistleblower disclosures, show a pattern of prioritizing engagement metrics over the well-being of younger users.
segments.tr: 주들은 이전 의회 조사와 내부 고발자 폭로를 통해 이미 드러난 내부 연구와 커뮤니케이션이 어린 사용자들의 안녕보다 참여 지표를 우선시하는 패턴을 보여준다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: The plaintiffs are seeking damages that, combined with civil penalties under state consumer-protection statutes, could theoretically reach into the trillions of dollars if applied across the full 29-state coalition — a figure that has made headlines even though any final award in this particular trial is expected to be far smaller.
segments.tr: 원고들은 주 소비자 보호법에 따른 민사 벌금과 합산할 경우 29개 주 전체 연합에 적용될 경우 이론적으로 수조 달러에 이를 수 있는 손해 배상을 요구하고 있으며, 이는 이번 특정 재판의 최종 배상액이 훨씬 적을 것으로 예상됨에도 불구하고 헤드라인을 장식한 수치입니다.

segments.src: ## How Meta Has Responded
segments.tr: ## 메타의 대응 방식

segments.src: Meta has firmly denied the states' central allegations.
segments.tr: 메타는 주들의 핵심 주장을 단호히 부인했습니다.

segments.src: In statements ahead of the trial, the company has said it has invested heavily in parental supervision tools, age-verification systems, default privacy protections for teen accounts, and features designed to encourage breaks from the app.
segments.tr: 재판을 앞둔 성명에서 회사는 부모 감독 도구, 연령 인증 시스템, 청소년 계정을 위한 기본 개인정보 보호 장치, 앱에서 휴식을 취하도록 장려하기 위해 설계된 기능에 막대한 투자를 했다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: Meta's legal team is expected to argue that the states are relying on selectively presented internal documents taken out of context, and that the company's product decisions were aimed at improving user experience and safety rather than exploiting it.
segments.tr: 메타의 법률팀은 주들이 맥락에서 벗어난 선택적으로 제시된 내부 문서에 의존하고 있으며, 회사의 제품 결정은 이를 악용하는 것이 아니라 사용자 경험과 안전을 개선하기 위한 것이었다고 주장할 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to industry-wide efforts, including its participation in initiatives with child-safety researchers and its rollout of Instagram Teen Accounts, as evidence that it has taken youth well-being seriously.
segments.tr: 또한 회사는 아동 안전 연구원들과의 이니셔티브 참여 및 인스타그램 10대 계정 출시를 포함한 업계 전반의 노력을 청소년의 안녕을 진지하게 다루어 왔다는 증거로 지적했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## 이 사건이 법정 밖에서도 중요한 이유

segments.src: Legal analysts following the litigation say the trial's significance extends well past any single verdict.
segments.tr: 소송을 추적하는 법률 분석가들은 재판의 중요성이 단일 평결을 훨씬 넘어선다고 말합니다.

segments.src: Because it is the first of many coordinated state cases to reach a jury, both sides are expected to use it to test arguments, evidence, and expert testimony that will likely reappear in future trials.
segments.tr: 조율된 주 소송 중 배심원단 앞에 도달한 첫 번째 사건이기 때문에, 양측 모두 향후 재판에서 다시 등장할 주장, 증거, 전문가 증언을 테스트하는 데 이를 사용할 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: 주들에게 유리한 판결은 미성년자를 대상으로 한 알고리즘 디자인과 데이터 수집에 대해 더 엄격한 규칙을 이미 제안한 규제 당국과 입법자들에게 힘을 실어줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: 반대로 메타의 승리는 적어도 단기적으로는 유사한 소송과 입법 제안 뒤에 있는 추진력을 둔화시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: 이 사건은 또한 소아과 의사, 학교 행정가, 학부모 옹호 단체들을 끌어들인 청소년 정신 건강과 소셜 미디어 사용에 대한 광범위한 국가적 대화 속에서 발생했습니다.

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: 공중보건 연구원들이 인용한 설문조사에 따르면 청소년의 과도한 소셜 미디어 사용은 불안율 증가 및 수면 방해와 연관되어 있지만, 연구원들은 특정 앱 기능과 정신 건강 결과 사이의 직접적인 인과관계를 확립하는 것은 여전히 과학적으로 복잡하며 재판에서 핵심 전장이 될 가능성이 높다고 경고합니다.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 다음 단계는 무엇인가

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: 오클랜드 재판은 몇 주 동안 진행될 것으로 예상되며 전·현직 메타 직원, 외부 심리학자, 양측이 고용한 데이터 과학자들의 증언이 포함될 것입니다.

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: 이것은 선도 사건이기 때문에, 주재 판사와 양측 법률팀은 배심원 평결을 통해서든 도달하기 전 협상된 합의를 통해서든 그 결과가 더 많은 사건이 재판으로 이어질지 아니면 광범위한 합의 회담으로 나아갈지를 포함하여 남은 주 소송이 어떻게 진행될지를 형성할 가능성이 높다고 시사했습니다.

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: 법정 밖에서 지켜보는 가족과 교육자들에게 이 사건은 기술 플랫폼이 젊은 사용자들을 위해 어떻게 설계되어야 하는지에 대한 질문이 더 이상 칼럼이나 의회 청문회에 국한되지 않고 이제 배심원단 앞에서 증거 하나하나로 시험되고 있음을 상기시켜 줍니다.

zh.title: 奥克兰审判：可能重塑 Meta 对待年轻用户方式的法律诉讼

segments.src: A closely watched federal trial got underway today in Oakland, California, opening what many legal observers describe as one of the most consequential consumer-protection cases involving a technology company in recent memory.
segments.tr: 一场备受关注的联邦审判今天在加利福尼亚州奥克兰拉开帷幕，开启了许多法律观察家所称的近年来涉及科技公司的最重要的消费者保护案件之一。

segments.src: Four states have brought claims against Meta Platforms, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, alleging that the company built and maintained product features that kept young users engaged in ways that caused them harm.
segments.tr: 四个州已对 Instagram 和 Facebook 的母公司 Meta Platforms 提起诉讼，指控该公司构建并维护了使年轻用户沉迷的产品功能，从而对他们造成了伤害。

segments.src: The case is the first bellwether trial to emerge from a much larger coalition of 29 states pursuing similar claims, meaning its outcome could set the tone for dozens of related lawsuits still waiting in the wings.
segments.tr: 此案是来自一个由 29 个州组成的更大联盟所提起的类似诉讼中的首个风向标案件，这意味着其结果可能会为数十起仍在等待审理的相关诉讼定下基调。

segments.src: ## What the States Are Alleging
segments.tr: ## 各州指控的内容

segments.src: According to court filings, attorneys representing the states argue that Meta's product teams studied how design elements such as infinite scroll, autoplay video, push notifications, and algorithmically curated feeds affect user behavior, and that the company chose to deploy features it knew could be habit-forming, particularly among teenagers and pre-teens.
segments.tr: 根据法庭文件，代表各州的律师辩称，Meta 的产品团队研究了无限滚动、自动播放视频、推送通知和算法策划的信息流等设计元素如何影响用户行为，并且该公司选择部署其明知可能会让人上瘾的功能，尤其是在青少年和青春期前儿童中。

segments.src: The states contend that internal research and communications, some of which have already surfaced through prior congressional inquiries and whistleblower disclosures, show a pattern of prioritizing engagement metrics over the well-being of younger users.
segments.tr: 各州主张，内部研究和通讯（其中一些已通过之前的国会调查和举报人披露而浮出水面）显示出一种将参与度指标置于年轻用户福祉之上的模式。

segments.src: The plaintiffs are seeking damages that, combined with civil penalties under state consumer-protection statutes, could theoretically reach into the trillions of dollars if applied across the full 29-state coalition — a figure that has made headlines even though any final award in this particular trial is expected to be far smaller.
segments.tr: 原告方寻求的赔偿金额，加上根据州消费者保护法规应处的民事罚款，如果适用于整个 29 州联盟，理论上可能达到数万亿美元——尽管预计此特定审判中的任何最终裁决金额将远低于此，但这一数字已成为头条新闻。

segments.src: ## How Meta Has Responded
segments.tr: ## Meta 的回应

segments.src: Meta has firmly denied the states' central allegations.
segments.tr: Meta 坚决否认了各州的核心指控。

segments.src: In statements ahead of the trial, the company has said it has invested heavily in parental supervision tools, age-verification systems, default privacy protections for teen accounts, and features designed to encourage breaks from the app.
segments.tr: 在审判前的声明中，该公司表示已在家长监督工具、年龄验证系统、青少年账户的默认隐私保护以及旨在鼓励用户从应用中休息的功能上投入了大量资金。

segments.src: Meta's legal team is expected to argue that the states are relying on selectively presented internal documents taken out of context, and that the company's product decisions were aimed at improving user experience and safety rather than exploiting it.
segments.tr: 预计 Meta 的法律团队将辩称，各州依赖的是断章取义的选择性内部文件，且该公司的产品决策旨在改善用户体验和安全性，而非利用用户。

segments.src: The company has also pointed to industry-wide efforts, including its participation in initiatives with child-safety researchers and its rollout of Instagram Teen Accounts, as evidence that it has taken youth well-being seriously.
segments.tr: 该公司还指出全行业的努力，包括参与儿童安全研究人员的倡议以及推出 Instagram 青少年账户，作为其认真对待青少年福祉的证据。

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## 为什么此案在法庭之外也很重要

segments.src: Legal analysts following the litigation say the trial's significance extends well past any single verdict.
segments.tr: 关注此诉讼的法律分析人士表示，审判的意义远超任何单一的判决。

segments.src: Because it is the first of many coordinated state cases to reach a jury, both sides are expected to use it to test arguments, evidence, and expert testimony that will likely reappear in future trials.
segments.tr: 由于这是众多协调一致的州级案件中首个进入陪审团审理的案件，预计双方都将利用它来测试可能在未来审判中再次出现的论点、证据和专家证词。

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: 对各州有利的裁决可能会鼓励监管机构和立法者，他们已经提议对针对未成年人的算法设计和数据收集实施更严格的规则。

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: 相反，Meta 的胜诉可能会在短期内减缓类似诉讼和立法提案的势头。

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: 此案也发生在一个关于青少年心理健康和社交媒体使用的更广泛的全国性对话背景下，这一对话已经吸引了儿科医生、学校管理人员和家长倡导团体的参与。

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: 公共卫生研究人员引用的调查将青少年过度使用社交媒体与焦虑率增加和睡眠中断联系起来，尽管研究人员提醒说，在特定应用功能与心理健康结果之间建立直接因果关系在科学上仍然很复杂，这本身也可能成为审判中的核心战场。

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## 接下来会发生什么

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: 奥克兰的审判预计将持续数周，并将包括来自 Meta 现任和前任员工、外部心理学家以及双方聘请的数据科学家的证词。

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: 由于这是一个风向标案件，主审法官和双方法律团队都表示，其结果——无论是通过陪审团裁决还是在裁决前达成和解——都可能会影响其余州级诉讼的进展，包括更多的案件是进入审判程序还是转向更广泛的和解谈判。

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: 对于在法庭外观察的家庭和教育工作者来说，此案提醒人们，关于科技平台如何为年轻用户设计的问题不再局限于评论文章和国会听证会——它们现在正逐一证据地在陪审团面前接受检验。

segments.tr: चार राज्यों ने इंस्टाग्राम और फेसबुक की मूल कंपनी, मेटा प्लेटफॉर्म्स के खिलाफ दावे किए हैं, जिसमें आरोप लगाया गया है कि कंपनी ने ऐसे उत्पाद फीचर्स बनाए और बनाए रखे जो युवा उपयोगकर्ताओं को इस तरह से जोड़े रखते थे जिससे उन्हें नुकसान पहुँचा।

segments.src: The case is the first bellwether trial to emerge from a much larger coalition of 29 states pursuing similar claims, meaning its outcome could set the tone for dozens of related lawsuits still waiting in the wings.
segments.tr: यह मामला समान दावों का पीछा करने वाले 29 राज्यों के एक बहुत बड़े गठबंधन से उभरने वाला पहला बेलवेदर ट्रायल (महत्वपूर्ण परीक्षण मामला) है, जिसका अर्थ है कि इसका परिणाम अभी भी कतार में खड़े दर्जनों संबंधित मुकदमों के लिए दिशा तय कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## What the States Are Alleging
segments.tr: ## राज्य क्या आरोप लगा रहे हैं

segments.src: According to court filings, attorneys representing the states argue that Meta's product teams studied how design elements such as infinite scroll, autoplay video, push notifications, and algorithmically curated feeds affect user behavior, and that the company chose to deploy features it knew could be habit-forming, particularly among teenagers and pre-teens.
segments.tr: अदालती दस्तावेजों के अनुसार, राज्यों का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले वकीलों का तर्क है कि मेटा की उत्पाद टीमों ने अध्ययन किया कि इनफिनिट स्क्रॉल, ऑटोप्ले वीडियो, पुश नोटिफिकेशन और एल्गोरिदम द्वारा क्यूरेट किए गए फीड जैसे डिज़ाइन तत्व उपयोगकर्ता के व्यवहार को कैसे प्रभावित करते हैं, और कंपनी ने उन फीचर्स को तैनात करने का विकल्प चुना जिनके बारे में वह जानती थी कि वे आदत डालने वाले हो सकते हैं, विशेष रूप से किशोरों और प्री-टीन (किशोरावस्था से पहले के बच्चों) के बीच।

segments.src: The states contend that internal research and communications, some of which have already surfaced through prior congressional inquiries and whistleblower disclosures, show a pattern of prioritizing engagement metrics over the well-being of younger users.
segments.tr: राज्यों का तर्क है कि आंतरिक शोध और संचार, जिनमें से कुछ पहले ही पिछली कांग्रेसी पूछताछ और व्हिसलब्लोअर के खुलासों के माध्यम से सामने आ चुके हैं, युवा उपयोगकर्ताओं की भलाई के बजाय जुड़ाव मेट्रिक्स (engagement metrics) को प्राथमिकता देने का एक पैटर्न दिखाते हैं।

segments.src: The plaintiffs are seeking damages that, combined with civil penalties under state consumer-protection statutes, could theoretically reach into the trillions of dollars if applied across the full 29-state coalition — a figure that has made headlines even though any final award in this particular trial is expected to be far smaller.
segments.tr: वादी ऐसे हर्जाने की मांग कर रहे हैं जो, राज्य उपभोक्ता-संरक्षण कानूनों के तहत नागरिक दंड के साथ मिलकर, सैद्धांतिक रूप से खरबों डॉलर तक पहुँच सकते हैं यदि उन्हें पूरे 29-राज्य गठबंधन में लागू किया जाए — एक ऐसा आंकड़ा जिसने सुर्खियां बटोरी हैं, भले ही इस विशेष मुकदमे में कोई भी अंतिम पुरस्कार बहुत छोटा होने की उम्मीद है।

segments.src: ## How Meta Has Responded
segments.tr: ## मेटा ने कैसे प्रतिक्रिया दी है

segments.src: Meta has firmly denied the states' central allegations.
segments.tr: मेटा ने राज्यों के मुख्य आरोपों का दृढ़ता से खंडन किया है।

segments.src: In statements ahead of the trial, the company has said it has invested heavily in parental supervision tools, age-verification systems, default privacy protections for teen accounts, and features designed to encourage breaks from the app.
segments.tr: मुकदमे से पहले के बयानों में, कंपनी ने कहा है कि उसने माता-पिता की निगरानी के उपकरणों, आयु-सत्यापन प्रणालियों, किशोर खातों के लिए डिफ़ॉल्ट गोपनीयता सुरक्षा, और ऐप से ब्रेक लेने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करने के लिए डिज़ाइन किए गए फीचर्स में भारी निवेश किया है।

segments.src: Meta's legal team is expected to argue that the states are relying on selectively presented internal documents taken out of context, and that the company's product decisions were aimed at improving user experience and safety rather than exploiting it.
segments.tr: मेटा की कानूनी टीम से यह तर्क देने की उम्मीद है कि राज्य संदर्भ से बाहर लिए गए चुनिंदा रूप से प्रस्तुत आंतरिक दस्तावेजों पर भरोसा कर रहे हैं, और कंपनी के उत्पाद निर्णय उपयोगकर्ता अनुभव और सुरक्षा में सुधार के उद्देश्य से थे, न कि इसका फायदा उठाने के लिए।

segments.src: The company has also pointed to industry-wide efforts, including its participation in initiatives with child-safety researchers and its rollout of Instagram Teen Accounts, as evidence that it has taken youth well-being seriously.
segments.tr: कंपनी ने उद्योग-व्यापी प्रयासों की ओर भी इशारा किया है, जिसमें बाल-सुरक्षा शोधकर्ताओं के साथ पहल में इसकी भागीदारी और इंस्टाग्राम टीन अकाउंट्स का रोलआउट शामिल है, इस बात के सबूत के रूप में कि उसने युवाओं की भलाई को गंभीरता से लिया है।

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## यह मामला अदालत के बाहर क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Legal analysts following the litigation say the trial's significance extends well past any single verdict.
segments.tr: मुकदमे का अनुसरण कर रहे कानूनी विश्लेषकों का कहना है कि मुकदमे का महत्व किसी भी एकल फैसले से कहीं आगे तक जाता है।

segments.src: Because it is the first of many coordinated state cases to reach a jury, both sides are expected to use it to test arguments, evidence, and expert testimony that will likely reappear in future trials.
segments.tr: चूंकि यह जूरी तक पहुँचने वाले कई समन्वित राज्य मामलों में से पहला है, इसलिए दोनों पक्षों द्वारा इसका उपयोग उन तर्कों, सबूतों और विशेषज्ञ गवाही का परीक्षण करने के लिए किए जाने की उम्मीद है जो संभवतः भविष्य के परीक्षणों में फिर से दिखाई देंगे।

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: राज्यों के पक्ष में फैसला उन नियामकों और सांसदों को प्रोत्साहित कर सकता है जिन्होंने पहले ही नाबालिगों के उद्देश्य से एल्गोरिथम डिज़ाइन और डेटा संग्रह पर सख्त नियमों का प्रस्ताव दिया है।

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, मेटा के लिए एक जीत समान मुकदमों और विधायी प्रस्तावों के पीछे की गति को धीमा कर सकती है, कम से कम निकट अवधि में।

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: यह मामला किशोर मानसिक स्वास्थ्य और सोशल मीडिया के उपयोग के बारे में एक व्यापक राष्ट्रीय बातचीत के बीच भी आया है, एक ऐसी बातचीत जिसमें बाल रोग विशेषज्ञ, स्कूल प्रशासक और अभिभावक वकालत समूह शामिल हो गए हैं।

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: सार्वजनिक स्वास्थ्य शोधकर्ताओं द्वारा उद्धृत सर्वेक्षणों ने किशोरों के बीच भारी सोशल मीडिया उपयोग को चिंता और नींद में खलल की बढ़ती दरों से जोड़ा है, हालांकि शोधकर्ता चेतावनी देते हैं कि विशिष्ट ऐप फीचर्स और मानसिक स्वास्थ्य परिणामों के बीच सीधा कारण स्थापित करना वैज्ञानिक रूप से जटिल बना हुआ है और यह स्वयं मुकदमे में एक केंद्रीय युद्ध का मैदान होने की संभावना है।

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: ओकलैंड ट्रायल के कई सप्ताह तक चलने की उम्मीद है और इसमें वर्तमान और पूर्व मेटा कर्मचारियों, बाहरी मनोवैज्ञानिकों और दोनों पक्षों द्वारा नियुक्त डेटा वैज्ञानिकों की गवाही शामिल होगी।

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: चूंकि यह एक बेलवेदर मामला है, इसलिए पीठासीन न्यायाधीश और दोनों कानूनी टीमों ने संकेत दिया है कि इसका परिणाम — चाहे जूरी के फैसले के माध्यम से हो या किसी के पहुँचने से पहले बातचीत के माध्यम से समझौता — संभवतः यह आकार देगा कि शेष राज्य के मुकदमे कैसे आगे बढ़ते हैं, जिसमें यह भी शामिल है कि क्या अधिक मामले मुकदमे में जाते हैं या व्यापक निपटान वार्ता की ओर बढ़ते हैं।

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: अदालत के बाहर से देख रहे परिवारों और शिक्षकों के लिए, यह मामला एक अनुस्मारक है कि युवा उपयोगकर्ताओं के लिए प्रौद्योगिकी प्लेटफॉर्म कैसे डिज़ाइन किए जाते हैं, इस बारे में सवाल अब राय के लेखों और कांग्रेसी सुनवाइयों तक सीमित नहीं हैं — उन्हें अब एक जूरी के सामने, सबूत दर सबूत, परखा जा रहा है।

es.title: Dentro del juicio de Oakland que podría redefinir cómo Meta trata a los usuarios jóvenes

segments.src: A closely watched federal trial got underway today in Oakland, California, opening what many legal observers describe as one of the most consequential consumer-protection cases involving a technology company in recent memory.
segments.tr: Un juicio federal muy observado comenzó hoy en Oakland, California, dando inicio a lo que muchos observadores legales describen como uno de los casos de protección al consumidor más trascendentales que involucran a una empresa tecnológica en la historia reciente.

segments.src: Four states have brought claims against Meta Platforms, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, alleging that the company built and maintained product features that kept young users engaged in ways that caused them harm.
segments.tr: Cuatro estados han presentado demandas contra Meta Platforms, la empresa matriz de Instagram y Facebook, alegando que la empresa construyó y mantuvo características de productos que mantuvieron a los usuarios jóvenes enganchados de maneras que les causaron daño.

segments.src: The case is the first bellwether trial to emerge from a much larger coalition of 29 states pursuing similar claims, meaning its outcome could set the tone for dozens of related lawsuits still waiting in the wings.
segments.tr: El caso es el primer juicio de prueba que surge de una coalición mucho más grande de 29 estados que persiguen demandas similares, lo que significa que su resultado podría marcar la pauta para decenas de demandas relacionadas que aún están en espera.

segments.src: ## What the States Are Alleging
segments.tr: ## Lo que alegan los estados

segments.src: According to court filings, attorneys representing the states argue that Meta's product teams studied how design elements such as infinite scroll, autoplay video, push notifications, and algorithmically curated feeds affect user behavior, and that the company chose to deploy features it knew could be habit-forming, particularly among teenagers and pre-teens.
segments.tr: Según los documentos judiciales, los abogados que representan a los estados argumentan que los equipos de producto de Meta estudiaron cómo los elementos de diseño como el desplazamiento infinito, la reproducción automática de videos, las notificaciones emergentes y los feeds curados algorítmicamente afectan el comportamiento del usuario, y que la empresa decidió implementar funciones que sabía que podían crear hábito, particularmente entre los adolescentes y preadolescentes.

segments.src: The states contend that internal research and communications, some of which have already surfaced through prior congressional inquiries and whistleblower disclosures, show a pattern of prioritizing engagement metrics over the well-being of younger users.
segments.tr: Los estados sostienen que la investigación y las comunicaciones internas, algunas de las cuales ya han salido a la luz a través de investigaciones previas del Congreso y declaraciones de denunciantes, muestran un patrón de priorización de las métricas de participación sobre el bienestar de los usuarios más jóvenes.

segments.src: The plaintiffs are seeking damages that, combined with civil penalties under state consumer-protection statutes, could theoretically reach into the trillions of dollars if applied across the full 29-state coalition — a figure that has made headlines even though any final award in this particular trial is expected to be far smaller.
segments.tr: Los demandantes buscan daños y perjuicios que, combinados con sanciones civiles bajo los estatutos estatales de protección al consumidor, teóricamente podrían alcanzar los billones de dólares si se aplican en toda la coalición de 29 estados, una cifra que ha ocupado titulares a pesar de que se espera que cualquier fallo final en este juicio en particular sea mucho menor.

segments.src: ## How Meta Has Responded
segments.tr: ## Cómo ha respondido Meta

segments.src: Meta has firmly denied the states' central allegations.
segments.tr: Meta ha negado rotundamente las alegaciones centrales de los estados.

segments.src: In statements ahead of the trial, the company has said it has invested heavily in parental supervision tools, age-verification systems, default privacy protections for teen accounts, and features designed to encourage breaks from the app.
segments.tr: En declaraciones previas al juicio, la empresa ha dicho que ha invertido fuertemente en herramientas de supervisión parental, sistemas de verificación de edad, protecciones de privacidad predeterminadas para cuentas de adolescentes y funciones diseñadas para fomentar descansos de la aplicación.

segments.src: Meta's legal team is expected to argue that the states are relying on selectively presented internal documents taken out of context, and that the company's product decisions were aimed at improving user experience and safety rather than exploiting it.
segments.tr: Se espera que el equipo legal de Meta argumente que los estados se basan en documentos internos presentados selectivamente y sacados de contexto, y que las decisiones de productos de la empresa tenían como objetivo mejorar la experiencia del usuario y la seguridad en lugar de explotarla.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to industry-wide efforts, including its participation in initiatives with child-safety researchers and its rollout of Instagram Teen Accounts, as evidence that it has taken youth well-being seriously.
segments.tr: La empresa también ha señalado los esfuerzos de toda la industria, incluida su participación en iniciativas con investigadores de seguridad infantil y su lanzamiento de Cuentas de Adolescentes de Instagram, como evidencia de que se ha tomado en serio el bienestar de los jóvenes.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## Por qué este caso importa más allá de la sala del tribunal

segments.src: Legal analysts following the litigation say the trial's significance extends well past any single verdict.
segments.tr: Los analistas legales que siguen el litigio dicen que la importancia del juicio se extiende mucho más allá de cualquier veredicto individual.

segments.src: Because it is the first of many coordinated state cases to reach a jury, both sides are expected to use it to test arguments, evidence, and expert testimony that will likely reappear in future trials.
segments.tr: Debido a que es el primero de muchos casos estatales coordinados en llegar a un jurado, se espera que ambas partes lo utilicen para probar argumentos, evidencia y testimonio de expertos que probablemente reaparecerán en futuros juicios.

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: Un fallo favorable a los estados podría envalentonar a los reguladores y legisladores que ya han propuesto reglas más estrictas sobre el diseño algorítmico y la recopilación de datos dirigida a menores.

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: Por el contrario, una victoria para Meta podría ralentizar el impulso detrás de demandas similares y propuestas legislativas, al menos a corto plazo.

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: El caso también llega en medio de una conversación nacional más amplia sobre la salud mental de los adolescentes y el uso de las redes sociales, una que ha atraído a pediatras, administradores escolares y grupos de defensa de los padres.

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: Las encuestas citadas por los investigadores de salud pública han vinculado el uso intensivo de las redes sociales entre los adolescentes con tasas aumentadas de ansiedad y sueño interrumpido, aunque los investigadores advierten que establecer una causalidad directa entre características específicas de las aplicaciones y los resultados de salud mental sigue siendo científicamente complejo y es probable que sea un campo de batalla central en el juicio.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sucede a continuación

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: Se espera que el juicio de Oakland dure varias semanas e incluirá testimonios de empleados actuales y anteriores de Meta, psicólogos externos y científicos de datos retenidos por ambas partes.

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: Debido a que este es un caso de prueba, el juez presidente y ambos equipos legales han indicado que su resultado, ya sea a través de un veredicto del jurado o un acuerdo negociado antes de que se alcance uno, probablemente dará forma a cómo proceden las demandas estatales restantes, incluida la posibilidad de que más casos vayan a juicio o avancen hacia conversaciones de conciliación más amplias.

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: Para las familias y educadores que observan desde fuera de la sala del tribunal, el caso es un recordatorio de que las preguntas sobre cómo se diseñan las plataformas tecnológicas para los usuarios jóvenes ya no se limitan a artículos de opinión y audiencias en el congreso, sino que ahora se están probando, evidencia por evidencia, frente a un jurado.

ar.title: داخل محاكمة أوكلاند التي قد تعيد صياغة كيفية تعامل ميتا مع المستخدمين الشباب

segments.src: A closely watched federal trial got underway today in Oakland, California, opening what many legal observers describe as one of the most consequential consumer-protection cases involving a technology company in recent memory.
segments.tr: بدأت اليوم محاكمة فدرالية تحظى بمتابعة دقيقة في أوكلاند، كاليفورنيا، لتفتتح ما يصفه العديد من المراقبين القانونيين بأنه إحدى أكثر قضايا حماية المستهلك أهمية والتي تتعلق بشركة تكنولوجيا في الذاكرة القريبة.

segments.src: Four states have brought claims against Meta Platforms, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, alleging that the company built and maintained product features that kept young users engaged in ways that caused them harm.
segments.tr: رفعت أربع ولايات دعاوى قضائية ضد شركة "ميتا بلاتفورمز"، الشركة المالكة لتطبيقي إنستغرام وفيس بوك، مزعمة أن الشركة قامت ببناء وصيانة ميزات منتجات تبقي المستخدمين الشباب منخرطين بطرق تسبب لهم الأضرار.

segments.src: The case is the first bellwether trial to emerge from a much larger coalition of 29 states pursuing similar claims, meaning its outcome could set the tone for dozens of related lawsuits still waiting in the wings.
segments.tr: هذه القضية هي أول محاكمة تمهيدية تنبثق عن تحالف أكبر بكثير يضم 29 ولاية تتابع مطالبات مماثلة، مما يعني أن النتيجة قد تحدد النبرة لعشرات الدعاوى القضائية ذات الصلة التي لا تزال تنتظر دورها.

segments.src: ## What the States Are Alleging
segments.tr: ## ما تزعمه الولایات

segments.src: According to court filings, attorneys representing the states argue that Meta's product teams studied how design elements such as infinite scroll, autoplay video, push notifications, and algorithmically curated feeds affect user behavior, and that the company chose to deploy features it knew could be habit-forming, particularly among teenagers and pre-teens.
segments.tr: وفقاً لملفات المحكمة، يجادل المحامون الممثلون للولايات بأن فرق المنتجات في شركة ميتا درست كيف تؤثر عناصر التصميم مثل التمرير اللانهائي، وتشغيل الفيديوهات تلقائياً، وإشعارات الدفع، والخلاصات المنسقة خوارزمياً على سلوك المستخدم، وأن الشركة اختارت نشر ميزات كانت تعلم أنها قد تسبب الإدمان، لا سيما بين المراهقين والأطفال قبل سن المراهقة.

segments.src: The states contend that internal research and communications, some of which have already surfaced through prior congressional inquiries and whistleblower disclosures, show a pattern of prioritizing engagement metrics over the well-being of younger users.
segments.tr: تؤكد الولايات أن الأبحاث والاتصالات الداخلية، وبعضها ظهر بالفعل من خلال تحقيقات الكونغرس السابقة وإفصاحات المبلّغين، تُظهر نمطاً من إعطاء الأولوية لمقاييس التفاعل على حساب رفاهية المستخدمين الأصغر سناً.

segments.src: The plaintiffs are seeking damages that, combined with civil penalties under state consumer-protection statutes, could theoretically reach into the trillions of dollars if applied across the full 29-state coalition — a figure that has made headlines even though any final award in this particular trial is expected to be far smaller.
segments.tr: يسعى المدعون إلى تعويضات، إلى جانب العقوبات المدنية بموجب قوانين حماية المستهلك في الولاية، يمكن أن تبلغ نظرياً تريليونات الدولارات إذا تم تطبيقها عبر التحالف الكامل المكون من 29 ولاية - وهو رقم أثار عناوين الصحف على الرغم من توقع أن يكون أي حكم نهائي في هذه المحاكمة بالذات أصغر بكثير.

segments.src: ## How Meta Has Responded
segments.tr: ## كيف استجابت ميتا

segments.src: Meta has firmly denied the states' central allegations.
segments.tr: رفضت شركة ميتا بحزم مزاعم الولايات المركزية.

segments.src: In statements ahead of the trial, the company has said it has invested heavily in parental supervision tools, age-verification systems, default privacy protections for teen accounts, and features designed to encourage breaks from the app.
segments.tr: في تصريحات سبق المحاكمة، قالت الشركة إنها استثمرت بشكل مكثف في أدوات الإشراف الأبوي، وأنظمة التحقق من العمر، وحماية الخصوصية الافتراضية لحسابات المراهقين، والميزات المصممة لتشجيع أخذ استراحات من التطبيق.

segments.src: Meta's legal team is expected to argue that the states are relying on selectively presented internal documents taken out of context, and that the company's product decisions were aimed at improving user experience and safety rather than exploiting it.
segments.tr: من المتوقع أن يجادل الفريق القانوني لشركة ميتا بأن الولايات تعتمد على وثائق داخلية مقدمة بشكل انتقائي وتم انتزاعها من سياقها، وأن قرارات منتجات الشركة كانت تهدف إلى تحسين تجربة المستخدم والسلامة بدلاً من استغلالها.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to industry-wide efforts, including its participation in initiatives with child-safety researchers and its rollout of Instagram Teen Accounts, as evidence that it has taken youth well-being seriously.
segments.tr: أشارت الشركة أيضاً إلى الجهود واسعة النطاق على مستوى الصناعة، بما في ذلك مشاركتها في مبادرات مع باحثي سلامة الأطفال وإطلاقها لحسابات إنستغرام للمراهقين، كدليل على أنها أخذت رفاهية الشباب على محمل الجد.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## لماذا تهم هذه القضية خارج قاعة المحكمة

segments.src: Legal analysts following the litigation say the trial's significance extends well past any single verdict.
segments.tr: يقول المحللون القانونيون الذين يتابعون التقاضي إن أهمية المحاكمة تمتد إلى ما بعد أي حكم فردي.

segments.src: Because it is the first of many coordinated state cases to reach a jury, both sides are expected to use it to test arguments, evidence, and expert testimony that will likely reappear in future trials.
segments.tr: ونظراً لكونها الأولى من بين العديد من قضايا الولايات المنسقة التي تصل إلى هيئة المحلفين، فمن المتوقع أن يستخدمها الطرفان لاختبار الحجج والأدلة وشهادات الخبراء التي من المرجح أن تظهر مرة أخرى في المحاكمات المستقبلية.

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: قد يؤدي الحكم المواتي للولايات إلى تشجيع المنظمين والمشرعين الذين اقترحوا بالفعل قواعد أكثر صارمة بشأن التصميم الخوارزمي وجمع البيانات التي تستهدف القاصرين.

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: وعلى العكس من ذلك، فإن فوز ميتا قد يبطئ الزخم الكامن وراء الدعاوى والمقترحات التشريعية المماثلة، على الأقل في المدى القريب.

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: تأتي القضية أيضاً وسط حوار وطني أوسع حول الصحة العقلية للمراهقين واستخدام وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، وهو حوار استقطب أطباء الأطفال، ومديري المرس، ومجموعات مناصرة الآباء.

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: ربطت الدراسات الاستقصائية التي استشهد بها باحثو الصحة العامة الاستخدام الكثيف لوسائل التواصل الاجتماعي بين المراهقين بزيادة معدلات القلق واضطراب النوم، على الرغم من أن الباحثين يحذرون من أن إقامة علاقة سببية مباشرة بين ميزات التطبيق المحددة ونتائج الصحة العقلية يظل أمراً معقداً علمياً ومن المرجح أن يكون بحد ذاته ساحة معركة مركزية في المحاكمة.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا يحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: من المتوقع أن تستمر محاكمة أوكلاند لعدة أسابيع وستشمل شهادات من موظفي ميتا الحاليين والسابقين، وعلماء نفس خارجيين، وعلماء بيانات استعان بهم الطرفان.

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: ونظراً لأن هذه قضية تمهيدية، فقد ألمح القاضي الناظر في القضية والفريقان القانونيان إلى أن نتيجتها - سواء من خلال حكم هيئة المحلفين أو تسوية تفاوضية قبل الوصول إليها - ستشكل على الأرجح كيفية سير دعاوى الولايات المتبقية، بما في ذلك ما إذا كانت المزيد من القضايا ستذهب إلى المحكمة أو تتجه نحو محادثات تسوية أوسع.

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للعائلات والمعلمين الذين يتابعون من خارج قاعة المحكمة، تعد القضية تذكيراً بأن الأسئلة حول كيفية تصميم منصات التكنولوجيا للمستخدمين الشباب لم تعد تقتصر على مقالات الرأي وجلسات الاستماع في الكونغرس - بل يتم اختبارها الآن، دليلاً تلو الآخر، أمام هيئة المحلفين.

fr.title: Au cœur du procès d'Oakland qui pourrait redéfinir la façon dont Meta traite les jeunes utilisateurs

segments.src: A closely watched federal trial got underway today in Oakland, California, opening what many legal observers describe as one of the most consequential consumer-protection cases involving a technology company in recent memory.
segments.tr: Un procès fédéral très surveillé a débuté aujourd'hui à Oakland, en Californie, ouvrant ce que de nombreux observateurs juridiques décrivent comme l'une des affaires de protection des consommateurs les plus importantes impliquant une entreprise technologique de mémoire récente.

segments.src: Four states have brought claims against Meta Platforms, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, alleging that the company built and maintained product features that kept young users engaged in ways that caused them harm.
segments.tr: Quatre États ont intenté des poursuites contre Meta Platforms, la maison mère d'Instagram et de Facebook, affirmant que l'entreprise a conçu et maintenu des fonctionnalités de produits qui ont incité les jeunes utilisateurs à rester engagés d'une manière qui leur a causé du tort.

segments.src: The case is the first bellwether trial to emerge from a much larger coalition of 29 states pursuing similar claims, meaning its outcome could set the tone for dozens of related lawsuits still waiting in the wings.
segments.tr: Cette affaire est le premier procès pilote issu d'une coalition beaucoup plus large de 29 États poursuivant des revendications similaires, ce qui signifie que son issue pourrait donner le ton à des dizaines de poursuites connexes qui attendent toujours.

segments.src: ## What the States Are Alleging
segments.tr: ## Ce que soutiennent les États

segments.src: According to court filings, attorneys representing the states argue that Meta's product teams studied how design elements such as infinite scroll, autoplay video, push notifications, and algorithmically curated feeds affect user behavior, and that the company chose to deploy features it knew could be habit-forming, particularly among teenagers and pre-teens.
segments.tr: Selon les documents judiciaires, les avocats représentant les États soutiennent que les équipes de produits de Meta ont étudié la manière dont les éléments de conception tels que le défilement infini, la lecture automatique des vidéos, les notifications push et les flux organisés par algorithme influencent le comportement des utilisateurs, et que l'entreprise a choisi de déployer des fonctionnalités qu'elle savait potentiellement addictives, en particulier chez les adolescents et les préadolescents.

segments.src: The states contend that internal research and communications, some of which have already surfaced through prior congressional inquiries and whistleblower disclosures, show a pattern of prioritizing engagement metrics over the well-being of younger users.
segments.tr: Les États soutiennent que des recherches et des communications internes, dont certaines ont déjà fait surface lors d'enquêtes parlementaires antérieures et de révocation de lanceurs d'alerte, montrent une tendance à privilégier les mesures d'engagement au détriment du bien-être des jeunes utilisateurs.

segments.src: The plaintiffs are seeking damages that, combined with civil penalties under state consumer-protection statutes, could theoretically reach into the trillions of dollars if applied across the full 29-state coalition — a figure that has made headlines even though any final award in this particular trial is expected to be far smaller.
segments.tr: Les plaignants réclament des dommages-intérêts qui, combinés aux amendes civiles prévues par les lois nationales sur la protection des consommateurs, pourraient théoriquement atteindre des billions de dollars si l'on appliquait l'ensemble de la coalition des 29 États — un chiffre qui a fait les gros titres, même si l'on s'attend à ce que toute condamnation finale dans ce procès particulier soit bien moindre.

segments.src: ## How Meta Has Responded
segments.tr: ## Comment Meta a réagi

segments.src: Meta has firmly denied the states' central allegations.
segments.tr: Meta a fermement nié les principales allégations des États.

segments.src: In statements ahead of the trial, the company has said it has invested heavily in parental supervision tools, age-verification systems, default privacy protections for teen accounts, and features designed to encourage breaks from the app.
segments.tr: Dans des déclarations précédant le procès, l'entreprise a affirmé avoir investi massivement dans des outils de surveillance parentale, des systèmes de vérification de l'âge, des protections de la vie privée par défaut pour les comptes d'adolescents et des fonctionnalités conçues pour encourager les pauses dans l'application.

segments.src: Meta's legal team is expected to argue that the states are relying on selectively presented internal documents taken out of context, and that the company's product decisions were aimed at improving user experience and safety rather than exploiting it.
segments.tr: L'équipe juridique de Meta devrait faire valoir que les États s'appuient sur des documents internes présentés de manière sélective et sortis de leur contexte, et que les décisions de l'entreprise en matière de produits visaient à améliorer l'expérience utilisateur et la sécurité plutôt qu'à les exploiter.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to industry-wide efforts, including its participation in initiatives with child-safety researchers and its rollout of Instagram Teen Accounts, as evidence that it has taken youth well-being seriously.
segments.tr: L'entreprise a également souligné les efforts menés à l'échelle de l'industrie, y compris sa participation à des initiatives avec des chercheurs spécialisés dans la sécurité des enfants et son lancement des comptes Instagram pour adolescents, comme preuve qu'elle prend au sérieux le bien-être des jeunes.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cette affaire dépasse le cadre de la salle d'audience

segments.src: Legal analysts following the litigation say the trial's significance extends well past any single verdict.
segments.tr: Les analystes juridiques qui suivent ce contentieux estiment que l'importance du procès va bien au-delà d'un simple verdict.

segments.src: Because it is the first of many coordinated state cases to reach a jury, both sides are expected to use it to test arguments, evidence, and expert testimony that will likely reappear in future trials.
segments.tr: Puisqu'il s'agit du premier de nombreux procès d'États coordonnés à être soumis à un jury, les deux parties devraient l'utiliser pour tester des arguments, des preuves et des témoignages d'experts qui réapparaîtront probablement lors de futurs procès.

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: Une décision favorable aux États pourrait enhardir les régulateurs et les législateurs qui ont déjà proposé des règles plus strictes sur la conception algorithmique et la collecte de données ciblant les mineurs.

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: À l'inverse, une victoire de Meta pourrait ralentir l'élan derrière des poursuites similaires et des propositions législatives, du moins à court terme.

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: L'affaire s'inscrit également dans le cadre d'un débat national plus large sur la santé mentale des adolescents et l'utilisation des réseaux sociaux, un sujet qui a mobilisé des pédiatres, des administrateurs scolaires et des groupes de défense des parents.

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: Les sondages cités par les chercheurs en santé publique ont établi un lien entre une utilisation intensive des réseaux sociaux chez les adolescents et des taux accrus d'anxiété et de troubles du sommeil, bien que les chercheurs préviennent qu'établir un lien de causalité direct entre des fonctionnalités spécifiques d'une application et des problèmes de santé mentale reste scientifiquement complexe et constituera probablement en soi un terrain d'affrontement central lors du procès.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Prochaines étapes

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: Le procès d'Oakland devrait durer plusieurs semaines et comprendra des témoignages d'employés actuels et anciens de Meta, de psychologues externes et de data scientists mandatés par les deux parties.

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: S'agissant d'un procès pilote, le juge président et les deux équipes juridiques ont indiqué que son issue — que ce soit par un verdict de jury ou un accord négocié avant qu'il ne soit atteint — façonnera probablement la manière dont les poursuites judiciaires restantes des États se dérouleront, notamment en déterminant si d'autres affaires iront jusqu'au procès ou s'orienteront vers des pourparlers de règlement plus larges.

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: Pour les familles et les éducateurs qui observent la situation depuis l'extérieur de la salle d'audience, l'affaire rappelle que les questions relatives à la manière dont les plateformes technologiques sont conçues pour les jeunes utilisateurs ne se limitent plus à des tribunes et à des auditions au Congrès : elles sont désormais testées, preuve par preuve, devant un jury.

segments.tr: A empresa também apontou para esforços em todo o setor, incluindo sua participação em iniciativas com pesquisadores de segurança infantil e o lançamento de Contas de Adolescentes no Instagram, como prova de que leva a sério o bem-estar dos jovens.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## Por que este caso é importante além do tribunal

segments.src: Legal analysts following the litigation say the trial's significance extends well past any single verdict.
segments.tr: Analistas jurídicos que acompanham o litígio dizem que o significado do julgamento vai muito além de qualquer veredito único.

segments.src: Because it is the first of many coordinated state cases to reach a jury, both sides are expected to use it to test arguments, evidence, and expert testimony that will likely reappear in future trials.
segments.tr: Como é o primeiro de muitos casos estaduais coordenados a chegar a um júri, espera-se que ambos os lados o utilizem para testar argumentos, evidências e depoimentos de especialistas que provavelmente reaparecerão em julgamentos futuros.

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: Uma decisão favorável aos estados poderia encorajar reguladores e legisladores que já propuseram regras mais rígidas sobre design algorítmico e coleta de dados voltados para menores.

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: Por outro lado, uma vitória para a Meta poderia diminuir o ímpeto por trás de processos e propostas legislativas semelhantes, pelo menos no curto prazo.

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: O caso também surge em meio a uma conversa nacional mais ampla sobre a saúde mental dos adolescentes e o uso das redes sociais, que atraiu pediatras, administradores escolares e grupos de defesa dos pais.

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: Pesquisas citadas por pesquisadores de saúde pública associaram o uso intenso de redes sociais entre adolescentes a taxas crescentes de ansiedade e sono perturbado, embora os pesquisadores alertem que estabelecer uma causalidade direta entre recursos específicos do aplicativo e resultados de saúde mental continua sendo cientificamente complexo e provavelmente será, por si só, um campo de batalha central no julgamento.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## O que acontece a seguir

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: Espera-se que o julgamento em Oakland dure várias semanas e inclua depoimentos de funcionários atuais e antigos da Meta, psicólogos externos e cientistas de dados contratados por ambos os lados.

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: Como este é um caso de referência, o juiz presidente e ambas as equipes jurídicas sinalizaram que seu resultado — seja por meio de um veredito do júri ou de um acordo negociado antes que um seja alcançado — provavelmente moldará como os processos estaduais restantes prosseguirão, incluindo se mais casos irão a julgamento ou avançarão para conversas de acordo mais amplas.

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: Para famílias e educadores que observam de fora do tribunal, o caso é um lembrete de que as questões sobre como as plataformas de tecnologia são projetadas para usuários jovens não estão mais confinadas a artigos de opinião e audiências no congresso — elas agora estão sendo testadas, evidência por evidência, diante de um júri.

in.title: Di Dalam Persidangan Oakland yang Dapat Mengubah Cara Meta Memperlakukan Pengguna Muda

segments.src: A closely watched federal trial got underway today in Oakland, California, opening what many legal observers describe as one of the most consequential consumer-protection cases involving a technology company in recent memory.
segments.tr: Sebuah persidangan federal yang diawasi ketat dimulai hari ini di Oakland, California, membuka apa yang digambarkan oleh banyak pengamat hukum sebagai salah satu kasus perlindungan konsumen paling penting yang melibatkan perusahaan teknologi dalam beberapa waktu terakhir.

segments.src: Four states have brought claims against Meta Platforms, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, alleging that the company built and maintained product features that kept young users engaged in ways that caused them harm.
segments.tr: Empat negara bagian telah mengajukan gugatan terhadap Meta Platforms, perusahaan induk Instagram dan Facebook, dengan tuduhan bahwa perusahaan tersebut membangun dan mempertahankan fitur produk yang membuat pengguna muda tetap terlibat dengan cara yang merugikan mereka.

segments.src: The case is the first bellwether trial to emerge from a much larger coalition of 29 states pursuing similar claims, meaning its outcome could set the tone for dozens of related lawsuits still waiting in the wings.
segments.tr: Kasus ini adalah persidangan perintis pertama yang muncul dari koalisi yang jauh lebih besar dari 29 negara bagian yang mengejar klaim serupa, yang berarti hasilnya dapat menjadi contoh bagi lusinan tuntutan hukum terkait yang masih menunggu.

segments.src: ## What the States Are Alleging
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dituduhkan oleh Negara Bagian

segments.src: According to court filings, attorneys representing the states argue that Meta's product teams studied how design elements such as infinite scroll, autoplay video, push notifications, and algorithmically curated feeds affect user behavior, and that the company chose to deploy features it knew could be habit-forming, particularly among teenagers and pre-teens.
segments.tr: Menurut dokumen pengadilan, para pengacara yang mewakili negara bagian berpendapat bahwa tim produk Meta mempelajari bagaimana elemen desain seperti pengguliran tak terbatas, video putar otomatis, pemberitahuan dorong, dan umpan yang dikurasi secara algoritmik memengaruhi perilaku pengguna, dan bahwa perusahaan memilih untuk menerapkan fitur yang mereka tahu dapat membentuk kebiasaan, terutama di kalangan remaja dan pra-remaja.

segments.src: The states contend that internal research and communications, some of which have already surfaced through prior congressional inquiries and whistleblower disclosures, show a pattern of prioritizing engagement metrics over the well-being of younger users.
segments.tr: Negara bagian berpendapat bahwa penelitian dan komunikasi internal, yang beberapa di antaranya telah muncul melalui penyelidikan kongres sebelumnya dan pengungkapan pelapor pelanggaran, menunjukkan pola memprioritaskan metrik keterlibatan daripada kesejahteraan pengguna yang lebih muda.

segments.src: The plaintiffs are seeking damages that, combined with civil penalties under state consumer-protection statutes, could theoretically reach into the trillions of dollars if applied across the full 29-state coalition — a figure that has made headlines even though any final award in this particular trial is expected to be far smaller.
segments.tr: Para penggugat mencari ganti rugi yang, jika digabungkan dengan hukuman perdata berdasarkan undang-undang perlindungan konsumen negara bagian, secara teoritis dapat mencapai triliunan dolar jika diterapkan di seluruh koalisi 29 negara bagian — angka yang telah menjadi berita utama meskipun setiap putaran akhir dalam persidangan khusus ini diharapkan jauh lebih kecil.

segments.src: ## How Meta Has Responded
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Tanggapan Meta

segments.src: Meta has firmly denied the states' central allegations.
segments.tr: Meta dengan tegas membantah tuduhan utama negara bagian tersebut.

segments.src: In statements ahead of the trial, the company has said it has invested heavily in parental supervision tools, age-verification systems, default privacy protections for teen accounts, and features designed to encourage breaks from the app.
segments.tr: Dalam pernyataan menjelang persidangan, perusahaan mengatakan telah berinvestasi besar-besaran dalam alat pengawasan orang tua, sistem verifikasi usia, perlindungan privasi default untuk akun remaja, dan fitur yang dirancang untuk mendorong istirahat dari aplikasi.

segments.src: Meta's legal team is expected to argue that the states are relying on selectively presented internal documents taken out of context, and that the company's product decisions were aimed at improving user experience and safety rather than exploiting it.
segments.tr: Tim hukum Meta diperkirakan akan berpendapat bahwa negara bagian mengandalkan dokumen internal yang disajikan secara selektif yang diambil dari konteksnya, dan bahwa keputusan produk perusahaan bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pengalaman dan keselamatan pengguna daripada mengeksploitasinya.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to industry-wide efforts, including its participation in initiatives with child-safety researchers and its rollout of Instagram Teen Accounts, as evidence that it has taken youth well-being seriously.
segments.tr: Perusahaan juga telah menunjuk pada upaya di seluruh industri, termasuk partisipasinya dalam inisiatif dengan peneliti keselamatan anak dan peluncuran Akun Remaja Instagram, sebagai bukti bahwa mereka menganggap serius kesejahteraan pemuda.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kasus Ini Penting di Luar Ruang Sidang

segments.tr: Analis hukum yang mengikuti litigasi tersebut mengatakan signifikansi persidangan meluas jauh melampaui vonis tunggal apa pun.

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: Keputusan yang menguntungkan bagi negara bagian dapat mendorong regulator dan pembuat undang-undang yang telah mengusulkan aturan yang lebih ketat pada desain algoritmik dan pengumpulan data yang ditujukan untuk anak di bawah umur.

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, kemenangan bagi Meta dapat memperlambat momentum di balik gugatan serupa dan proposal legislatif, setidaknya dalam waktu dekat.

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: Kasus ini juga tiba di tengah percakapan nasional yang lebih luas tentang kesehatan mental remaja dan penggunaan media sosial, yang telah menarik dokter anak, administrator sekolah, dan kelompok advokasi orang tua.

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: Survei yang dikutip oleh peneliti kesehatan masyarakat telah menghubungkan penggunaan media sosial yang berat di kalangan remaja dengan peningkatan tingkat kecemasan dan gangguan tidur, meskipun peneliti memperingatkan bahwa menetapkan hubungan sebab akibat langsung antara fitur aplikasi tertentu dan hasil kesehatan mental tetap rumit secara ilmiah dan kemungkinan besar akan menjadi medan pertempuran utama di persidangan.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Selanjutnya

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: Persidangan Oakland diharapkan berlangsung selama beberapa minggu dan akan mencakup kesaksian dari karyawan Meta saat ini dan sebelumnya, psikolog luar, dan ilmuwan data yang dipekerjakan oleh kedua belah pihak.

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: Karena ini adalah kasus perintis, hakim yang memimpin dan kedua tim hukum telah mengisyaratkan bahwa hasilnya — baik melalui putusan juri atau penyelesaian yang negosiasikan sebelum tercapai — kemungkinan besar akan membentuk bagaimana gugatan negara bagian yang tersisa berjalan, termasuk apakah lebih banyak kasus pergi ke persidangan atau bergerak menuju pembicaraan penyelesaian yang lebih luas.

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: Bagi keluarga dan pendidik yang menonton dari luar ruang sidang, kasus ini adalah pengingat bahwa pertanyaan tentang bagaimana platform teknologi dirancang untuk pengguna muda tidak lagi terbatas pada artikel opini dan sidang kongres — mereka sekarang sedang diuji, bukti demi bukti, di depan juri.

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.

segments.tr: ## Was die Bundesstaaten vorbringen

segments.src: According to court filings, attorneys representing the states argue that Meta's product teams studied how design elements such as infinite scroll, autoplay video, push notifications, and algorithmically curated feeds affect user behavior, and that the company chose to deploy features it knew could be habit-forming, particularly among teenagers and pre-teens.
segments.tr: Gerichtsakten zufolge argumentieren die Anwälte der Bundesstaaten, dass Metas Produktteams untersucht hätten, wie Designelemente wie endloses Scrollen, Autoplay-Videos, Push-Benachrichtigungen und algorithmisch kuratierte Feeds das Nutzerverhalten beeinflussen, und dass sich das Unternehmen dafür entschieden habe, Funktionen bereitzustellen, von denen es wusste, dass sie süchtig machen könnten, insbesondere bei Teenagern und Vorher-Teenagern.

segments.src: The states contend that internal research and communications, some of which have already surfaced through prior congressional inquiries and whistleblower disclosures, show a pattern of prioritizing engagement metrics over the well-being of younger users.
segments.tr: Die Bundesstaaten behaupten, dass interne Untersuchungen und Mitteilungen, von denen einige bereits durch frühere Anfragen des Kongresses und Enthüllungen von Whistleblowern ans Licht gekommen sind, ein Muster zeigen, bei dem Engagement-Metriken über das Wohlbefinden jüngerer Nutzer gestellt werden.

segments.src: The plaintiffs are seeking damages that, combined with civil penalties under state consumer-protection statutes, could theoretically reach into the trillions of dollars if applied across the full 29-state coalition — a figure that has made headlines even though any final award in this particular trial is expected to be far smaller.
segments.tr: Die Kläger fordern Schadensersatz, der in Kombination mit zivilrechtlichen Strafen nach den Verbraucherschutzgesetzen der Bundesstaaten theoretisch in die Billionen von Dollar gehen könnte, wenn er auf die gesamte Koalition aus 29 Bundesstaaten angewendet würde – eine Zahl, die Schlagzeilen gemacht hat, obwohl jeder endgültige Zuspruch in diesem speziellen Prozess voraussichtlich weitaus geringer ausfallen wird.

segments.src: ## How Meta Has Responded
segments.tr: ## Wie Meta reagiert hat

segments.src: Meta has firmly denied the states' central allegations.
segments.tr: Meta hat die zentralen Vorwürfe der Bundesstaaten entschieden zurückgewiesen.

segments.src: In statements ahead of the trial, the company has said it has invested heavily in parental supervision tools, age-verification systems, default privacy protections for teen accounts, and features designed to encourage breaks from the app.
segments.tr: In Erklärungen im Vorfeld des Prozesses erklärte das Unternehmen, es habe massiv in elterliche Überwachungstools, Altersverifikationssysteme, standardmäßige Datenschutzeinstellungen für Teenagerkonten und Funktionen investiert, die dazu anregen sollen, Pausen von der App einzulegen.

segments.src: Meta's legal team is expected to argue that the states are relying on selectively presented internal documents taken out of context, and that the company's product decisions were aimed at improving user experience and safety rather than exploiting it.
segments.tr: Metas Rechtsteam wird voraussichtlich argumentieren, dass sich die Bundesstaaten auf selektiv präsentierte interne Dokumente verlassen, die aus dem Zusammenhang gerissen wurden, und dass die Produktentscheidungen des Unternehmens darauf abzielten, die Nutzererfahrung und -sicherheit zu verbessern, anstatt sie auszunutzen.

segments.src: The company has also pointed to industry-wide efforts, including its participation in initiatives with child-safety researchers and its rollout of Instagram Teen Accounts, as evidence that it has taken youth well-being seriously.
segments.tr: Das Unternehmen hat auch auf branchenweite Bemühungen verwiesen, darunter seine Teilnahme an Initiativen mit Kinderschutzzahlern und die Einführung von Instagram Teen Accounts, als Beweis dafür, dass es das Wohlbefinden von Jugendlichen ernst nimmt.

segments.src: ## Why This Case Matters Beyond the Courtroom
segments.tr: ## Warum dieser Fall über den Gerichtssaal hinaus wichtig ist

segments.src: Legal analysts following the litigation say the trial's significance extends well past any single verdict.
segments.tr: Rechtsanalysten, die das Verfahren verfolgen, sagen, dass die Bedeutung des Prozesses weit über ein einzelnes Urteil hinausgeht.

segments.src: Because it is the first of many coordinated state cases to reach a jury, both sides are expected to use it to test arguments, evidence, and expert testimony that will likely reappear in future trials.
segments.tr: Da es sich um den ersten von vielen koordinierten Verfahren der Bundesstaaten handelt, die vor eine Jury kommen, wird erwartet, dass beide Seiten ihn nutzen werden, um Argumente, Beweise und Sachverständigenaussagen zu testen, die in zukünftigen Prozessen wahrscheinlich wieder auftauchen werden.

segments.src: A ruling favorable to the states could embolden regulators and lawmakers who have already proposed stricter rules on algorithmic design and data collection aimed at minors.
segments.tr: Ein für die Bundesstaaten günstiges Urteil könnte Regulierungsbehörden und Gesetzgeber ermutigen, die bereits strengere Regeln für algorithmisches Design und Datenerfassung für Minderjährige vorgeschlagen haben.

segments.src: Conversely, a win for Meta could slow momentum behind similar suits and legislative proposals, at least in the near term.
segments.tr: Umgekehrt könnte ein Sieg für Meta die Dynamik hinter ähnlichen Klagen und Gesetzgebungsvorschlägen verlangsamen, zumindest kurzfristig.

segments.src: The case also arrives amid a broader national conversation about adolescent mental health and social media use, one that has drawn in pediatricians, school administrators, and parent advocacy groups.
segments.tr: Der Fall kommt auch inmitten einer breiteren nationalen Debatte über die psychische Gesundheit von Jugendlichen und die Nutzung sozialer Medien, die Kinderärzte, Schulverwalter und Interessenverbände von Eltern einbezogen hat.

segments.src: Surveys cited by public health researchers have linked heavy social media use among teens to increased rates of anxiety and disrupted sleep, though researchers caution that establishing direct causation between specific app features and mental health outcomes remains scientifically complex and is itself likely to be a central battleground at trial.
segments.tr: Von Public-Health-Forschern zitierte Umfragen haben eine starke Nutzung sozialer Medien bei Teenagern mit erhöhten Angstzuständen und gestörtem Schlaf in Verbindung gebracht, obwohl Forscher warnen, dass die Herstellung einer direkten Kausalität zwischen spezifischen App-Funktionen und Ergebnissen der psychischen Gesundheit wissenschaftlich komplex bleibt und selbst wahrscheinlich ein zentraler Kampfplatz vor Gericht sein wird.

segments.src: ## What Happens Next
segments.tr: ## Was als Nächstes passiert

segments.src: The Oakland trial is expected to run for several weeks and will include testimony from current and former Meta employees, outside psychologists, and data scientists retained by both sides.
segments.tr: Der Oakland-Prozess wird voraussichtlich mehrere Wochen dauern und Aussagen von aktuellen und ehemaligen Meta-Mitarbeitern, externen Psychologen und von beiden Seiten beauftragten Datenwissenschaftlern umfassen.

segments.src: Because this is a bellwether case, the presiding judge and both legal teams have signaled that its outcome — whether through a jury verdict or a negotiated settlement before one is reached — will likely shape how the remaining state lawsuits proceed, including whether more cases go to trial or move toward broader settlement talks.
segments.tr: Da es sich um einen wegweisenden Fall handelt, haben der vorsitzende Richter und beide Rechtsteams signalisiert, dass sein Ausgang – sei es durch ein Juryurteil oder eine ausgehandelte Einigung, bevor eine erzielt wird – wahrscheinlich prägen wird, wie die verbleibenden Klagen der Bundesstaaten fortgesetzt werden, einschließlich der Frage, ob mehr Fälle vor Gericht gehen oder sich in Richtung breiterer Vergleichsgespräche bewegen.

segments.src: For families and educators watching from outside the courtroom, the case is a reminder that questions about how technology platforms are designed for young users are no longer confined to opinion pieces and congressional hearings — they are now being tested, evidence by evidence, in front of a jury.
segments.tr: Für Familien und Pädagogen, die von außerhalb des Gerichtssaals zusehen, ist der Fall eine Erinnerung daran, dass Fragen darüber, wie Technologieplattformen für junge Nutzer gestaltet werden, nicht länger auf Meinungsartikel und Kongressanhörungen beschränkt sind – sie werden jetzt Beweis für Beweis vor einer Jury getestet.

vi.title: Bên trong Phiên tòa ở Oakland có thể định hình lại cách Meta đối xử với người dùng trẻ tuổi

segments.src: A closely watched federal trial got underway today in Oakland, California, opening what many legal observers describe as one of the most consequential consumer-protection cases involving a technology company in recent memory.
segments.tr: Một phiên tòa liên bang được theo dõi chặt chẽ đã diễn ra vào hôm nay tại Oakland, California, mở ra điều mà nhiều nhà quan sát pháp lý mô tả là một trong những vụ kiện bảo vệ người tiêu dùng quan trọng nhất liên quan đến một công ty công nghệ trong thời gian gần đây.

segments.src: Four states have brought claims against Meta Platforms, the parent company of Instagram and Facebook, alleging that the company built and maintained product features that kept young users engaged in ways that caused them harm.
segments.tr: Bốn bang đã đệ đơn kiện chống lại Meta Platforms, công ty mẹ của Instagram và Facebook, cáo buộc rằng công ty đã xây dựng và duy trì các tính năng sản phẩm khiến người dùng trẻ tuổi tiếp tục sử dụng theo những cách gây tổn hại cho họ.

segments.src: The case is the first bellwether trial to emerge from a much larger coalition of 29 states pursuing similar claims, meaning its outcome could set the tone for dozens of related lawsuits still waiting in the wings.
segments.tr: Vụ án này là phiên tòa định hướng đầu tiên xuất hiện từ một liên minh lớn hơn nhiều gồm 29 bang theo đuổi các khiếu nại tương tự, nghĩa là kết quả của nó có thể tạo tiền lệ cho hàng chục vụ kiện liên quan vẫn đang chờ xử lý.
